apiclients.info: An API client is an uploaded Swagger or OpenAPI document plus the bindings that say which operation lists candidates and which one resolves a stored id. Nothing is generated: the document is interpreted at runtime, so a new service is an upload rather than a build.
apiclients.list.title: Clients
apiclients.list.empty: No clients yet. Upload a Swagger or OpenAPI document to add one.
apiclients.editor.idle: Pick a client on the left, or upload a document to add one.
apiclients.new.title: New API client
apiclients.new.id_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore. Used as the filename.
apiclients.new.name: Display name
apiclients.field.name: Display name
apiclients.field.base_url_hint: Where calls actually go. Leave empty to use the first server the document declares.
apiclients.field.spec_url_hint: Where the document came from. Independent of the base URL, and only used to check for drift.
apiclients.field.dialect_hint: A preset filling in entity addressing and paging defaults. Every resource can override them.
apiclients.auth.credential_locked: Unlock the vault to see or change this
apiclients.auth.credential_hint: Kept encrypted in the vault under category "api-client". It never travels with a sync.
apiclients.resource.empty: No resources yet. A resource binds one collection to the operations that list and fetch it.
apiclients.resource.key_hint: How a field refers to this collection.
apiclients.resource.label: Label
apiclients.resource.get_op_hint: Resolves a stored id back to a record. Optional: without it, the saved label carries the display.
apiclients.resource.items_path_hint: JSON pointer to the array in the list response. Empty means the response is the array.
apiclients.resource.search_template_hint: Optional. Use {'{'}q{'}'} for the typed text, for services that filter through an expression: contains(Name,'{'{'}q{'}'}').
apiclients.resource.select_param_hint: Optional. Pushes the field selection to the server, so asking for two fields fetches two columns.
apiclients.resource.fields_hint: The menu a consuming field picks from. Each one names a value to pull out of a record.
apiclients.test.title: Try it
apiclients.test.empty: The call succeeded and returned no rows.
apiclients.test.hint: Runs the list binding against the real service, exactly as a field's picker would.
apiclients.validation.title: Problems
apiclients.validation.clean: Every binding checks out against the document.
apiclients.toast.spec_failed: That document could not be read: {0}
apiclients.confirm.delete_message: Delete "{0}"? Its document and stored credential go too, and any field using it stops resolving.
